'''''Life Day Kashyyyk''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] made sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It was part of a series of three paintings, alongside ''[[Life Day Matriarch]]'' and ''[[Life Day Patriarch]]'', that were made for the festivities of [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]]. The painting in question depicted sceneries of white trees on some hills with more hills in the distance. It was supplied during the events of an annual Life Day celebration on Kashyyyk.

==Behind the scenes==
''Life Day Kashyyyk'', alongside ''Life Day Patriarch'' and ''Life Day Matriarch'', were supplied randomly to players who chose a painting instead of a Life Day orb, although they could skip both altogether if they only asked for a robe and were also Wookiees. As of 2005, it is no longer available, and thus is considered a collector's item.
